title: Manhattanhenge for every British town
excerpt: On which days does the sun set straight down your street? I worked it out for 37,224 straight streets in 377 UK towns and cities, with the hills on the skyline. 1,072 line up with a solstice, about as many as chance would give, and Midsummer Boulevard in Milton Keynes misses midsummer.
seo_description: The days the sun sets straight down 37,224 streets in 377 UK towns, and why Midsummer Boulevard misses midsummer.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Manhattanhenge for every British town' on parchment beside a stylised sunset at the end of a street lined with blocks, with the line '1,072 solstice streets, no more than chance'.
